Title: Founder
Description: Founder of Harvics Global Ventures, an international consumer goods platform operating across food and textiles, with a focus on private label development, manufacturing alignment, and international market entry.  Harvics works with accredited manufacturing partners and commercial stakeholders to support retailers, distributors, and brand owners through: • Private label and exclusive supply development • Category-led product and packaging evolution • Manufacturing capability and compliance alignment • Risk-managed expansion into new markets across food and textile categories  The platform is designed to bridge manufacturing capability with market expectations, enabling scalable, compliant, and commercially viable growth rather than transactional trading.

Title: Vice President Marketing and Sales
Description: HiloCorp is an international textile buying house providing end-to-end supply chain solutions for retailers and brand owners. The company supports clients across supplier identification, product development, textile sourcing, quality assurance, logistics coordination, and inventory management, with a focus on responsibly managing time-sensitive textile supply chains. Responsibilities include: International buyer engagement and account management Private label and OEM textile program development Supplier onboarding, costing, and margin alignment Coordination with manufacturing, quality, and production planning teams Ensuring delivery performance, quality compliance, and buyer specification alignment The role focuses on building long-term sourcing partnerships and operational reliability for modern retail environments rather than transactional trading.

Title: Vice President – Sales & Commercial Operations (Textiles)
Description: Led commercial and sales operations for a textile manufacturing group supplying private label and OEM programs to international buyers.  Key responsibilities included: • Private label and OEM textile program development • Coordination with manufacturing, quality, and production planning teams • Costing, margin management, and order execution • International buyer engagement and long-term account management • Ensuring delivery performance, quality alignment, and compliance with buyer specifications  This role built the operational, costing, and supply discipline later applied to multi-category consumer goods and private label platforms.

Title: Public Policy & Strategic Advisory (Non-Commercial)
Description: • Conducted in-depth analytical and research work on international governance frameworks, economic development models, and institutional risk assessment.  • Developed structured analytical inputs and scenario assessments related to economic stability, investment environments, and policy impact evaluation.  • Contributed to crisis analysis and risk-mitigation studies focused on institutional resilience, continuity planning, and impact containment across complex environments.  • Engagements were research- and analysis-oriented, involving coordination with public-sector bodies, multilateral institutions, and civil society organisations for information gathering and contextual understanding.  • All work was non-operational, non-commercial, and advisory in nature, with no role in decision-making, enforcement, lobbying, or influence activities.

Title: Director Marketing and Sales
Description: Led marketing and international sales functions for a vertically integrated textile manufacturing group supplying private label and OEM programs to overseas buyers.  Key responsibilities included: • International buyer acquisition and relationship management • Development of private label and OEM textile programs • Coordination with production, quality, and merchandising teams • Pricing, costing, and margin structuring for export markets • Order execution oversight and delivery performance alignment • Market expansion across Europe, UK, and other export destinations  This role established strong foundations in textile sourcing, export sales, buyer compliance, and long-term account management within international retail supply chains.
